name: async-view
title: Async view
description: Every state of a data view in one wrapper: loading, error with Retry, empty, background refresh and ready, each with a slot and a default.
docs: It fetches nothing: pass status ('loading' | 'error' | 'empty' | 'ready') and isFetching from TanStack Query, SWR or a plain useState. The skeleton waits loadingDelay (200 ms) so a quick load never flashes one; a background refresh keeps the old content and runs a thin bar along the top. The region carries aria-busy and a polite status announces each change. Pass skeleton, error and empty to replace a default, or errorTitle, errorMessage and onRetry to adjust the built-in error panel.
